title.narrative: Sustaining and Improving the Gains for HIV and TB - Zambia (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Zambia, TB/HIV, Churches Health Association of Zambia (CHAZ)This program has the following goals: The NASF 2023-2027 strives to contribute to ending AIDS by 2030 through universal access to comprehensive HIV prevention, treatment, care, support and not leaving anyone behind.. End TB by 2030. The objectives of this program are: Reduce new HIV infections from 28,000 in 2022 to least 15,000 by 2027. Reduce AIDS related mortality by 50% from 20,000 in 2022. Reduce HIV related stigma and discrimination by 50%. Increase domestic financing of the HIV response to 30% by 2027 from 13.8% in 2017. Mother to child transmission of HIV eliminated, from 3.5% in 2022 to less than 3%, by 2027. TB incidences decrease from 319 to 160 per 100,000 population.. Reduce TB mortality from 19 per 100,000 population in 2021 to 6 per 100, 000 population in 2026. Reduce families facing catastrophic due to TB (The value will be determinedduring the life of this NSP after results of the “out of Pocket study are out)
